usedFor: Wildapricot holds members, payments and events, and TRIGGERcmd runs a command on your computer through “Trigger Command”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Payment Arrives” in Wildapricot, then “Trigger Command” in TRIGGERcmd
bestTemplate.why: A payment is a clear signal to run a local step on your machine, like updating a file.

watchOut: “Membership Is Suspended” and “New Refund Created” are sensitive events, so check which command each one starts.
